in_sanskrit.name: चतुर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chaten is derived from the Sanskrit word चतुर (Chatur), which means 'Four'. This name is commonly used in Hindu culture to signify the number four, which holds significant importance in various rituals and beliefs.

in_hindi.name: चठेन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chaten in Hindi is a combination of the words चतुर (Chatur), which means 'Four', and धन (Dhan), which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. The name Chaten is often given to a baby boy born as the fourth child in a family, symbolizing the belief that every child brings wealth and prosperity to the family.

in_tamil.name: சதன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chaten in Tamil is derived from the Tamil word சத்தி (Saththi), which means 'existence' or 'reality'. The name Chaten can be interpreted as one who embodies the reality and existence of the universe.

in_telugu.name: చతేన
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chaten in Telugu is derived from the Telugu word చెప్పు (Cheppu), which means 'eighth'. While the name Chaten is not commonly used in Hindu culture with this meaning, it can be considered a variant of the name, derived from the Sanskrit word अष्ट (Ashtha), which means 'eight'.
